test_dataframe_subclassing_and_slicing: test that subclassing DataFrame preserves the custom class when slicing rows and selecting columns
test_dataframe_metadata_preservation: test that custom attributes and metadata are preserved through indexing, slicing, and pickle round-trips
test_subclass_align: test that aligning two subclassed DataFrames or Series returns results of the correct subclass type
test_subclass_stack_unstack: test that stack and unstack operations on subclassed DataFrames with MultiIndex preserve the subclass type
test_subclass_operations: test that pivot, melt, wide_to_long, apply, reductions, isin, duplicated, idxmax, idxmin, dot, and convert_dtypes preserve subclass types
